thread:
Anya: heads-up: we need a 'golden-path' for error contracts + a migration plan so partner integrations don't break. saw a partner parse message text -> huge mess.

MattG: agreed. propose: public contract v1 = {code, http_status, message, human_action, retryable, retry_after?, error_id}. keep Error.message as legacy text for one release, but add Error.code and Error.http_status fields immediately.

Sarah-L: +1. Also add SDK helpers: error.isRetryable(), error.isAuth(), and a small mapping lib like `mapHttpToCode(status, headers)` so frontends don't guess.

Kai: migration path idea: 1) release SDKs with envelope added but keep message string, 2) update sampleapp and docs, 3) emit telemetry flag `error_contract=v1`, 4) after 3 months remove legacy message-parsing. communicate in changelog + partners email.

Anya: can we include a compatibility shim for server responses? e.g., server can send `x-error-code` header for older clients and we map it on the SDK side. That helps early rollouts.

MattG: good idea. JS shim can check `resp.headers.get('x-error-code')` then normalize. We'll add a deprecation warning when used. Code snippet for JS error class:
```js
class RedwoodError extends Error {
  constructor({code, http_status, message, retryable, retry_after, error_id}) {
    super(message)
    this.code = code
    this.http_status = http_status
    this.retryable = !!retryable
    this.retry_after = retry_after || null
    this.error_id = error_id || null
  }
}
```

Sarah-L: and python equivalent should subclass Exception with attributes and friendly __str__. tests should assert serialization to JSON matches envelope keys and that unknown errors fall back to `code: unknown_error`.

Kai: telemetry: include code, http_status, error_id, contract_version. don't include stack or token values. log human_action as a short string for product mapping.

Anya: sampleapp UX: default user-facing copy = human_action or fallback message 'Something went wrong'. add a "Developer details" expand panel containing error_id, raw envelope, and stack. do NOT show raw headers.

Dev-bot: created GH issue #5110 "error contract v1 + migration plan" https://github.com/redwood/infra/issues/5110 :spiral_note_pad:

MattG: test matrix: unit + integration + churn test across versions. e2e: old server header x-error-code -> new sdk populates Error.code. compatibility: add opt-in env var `RW_STRICT_ERRORS=true` to fail fast in internal envs.

Sarah-L: copy notes: insist on snake_case stable codes (rate_limit, auth_expired, transient_service, model_failure, unknown_error). include brief human_action examples in the spec doc.

Kai: I'll take server header shim + python exceptions. MattG you ok to own JS shim + sampleapp UI?

MattG: yep. will open small PRs. target: SDK micro-release this week, sampleapp update next week.

Anya: thanks. let's also add a short partner-facing FAQ before rolling out. :white_check_mark:
